<function name="SetNetworked2Var" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets a networked value on the entity.

The value can then be accessed with <page>Entity:GetNetworked2Var</page> both from client and server.

| Allowed Types   |  
| --------------- |  
| Angle           |  
| Boolean         |  
| Entity          |  
| Float           |  
| Int             |  
| String          |  
| Vector          |  
<deprecated>You should be using <page>Entity:SetNW2Var</page> instead.</deprecated>
<warning>Trying to network a type that is not listed above leads to the value not being networked!</warning>
<note>Running this function clientside will only set it for the client it is called on.  
The value will only be networked if it isn't the same as the current value and unlike SetNW*
the value will only ne networked once and not every 10 seconds.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key to associate the value with</arg>
		<arg name="value" type="any">The value to set</arg>
	</args>
</function>
